# dist/ — generated

Built from `skills/` by `build.py`. Don't edit anything here; edit the source and rebuild.

| Directory | For |
|---|---|
| `universal/` | Paste into any assistant — also the files you upload as knowledge |
| `instructions/` | Short stubs for capped instruction fields (Custom GPTs, Gems, Grok) |
| `platforms/` | Install notes per assistant |
| `agents/` | AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions |

Claude Code reads `skills/` directly through the plugin manifest — no build step.
